vote.question: [US-OK - U.S. Senate]: Kevin Hern (R) has received $22,128,721 in career campaign contributions (with $13,374,945 this cycle, alongside $219,789 in outside Super PAC support led by High Plains PAC)—linked to "Extractive Energy & Petrochemical Capture". Do you vote to formally rebuke Kevin Hern for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent his constituents by upholding his core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet Kevin Hern has amassed $22,128,721 in career contributions (with $13,374,945 this cycle, alongside $219,789 in outside Super PAC support led by High Plains PAC)—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure Kevin Hern on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

options: Yes — Formally Rebuke & Direct Escrow to Local Restitution

outcomes.YES_RELEASE_TO_LOCAL_CHARITIES: Directs 100% of the funds to verified local non-profits working directly on state community needs.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-OK: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving OK dedicated to clean water remediation, community grid resilience, and environmental health clinics. Verified local recipients: LAND LEGACY (US-EIN:300137741); OKLAHOMA ASSOCIATION OF CONSERVATION DISTRICTS INCORPORATE (US-EIN:730801393); COMPATIBLE LANDS FOUNDATION INC (US-EIN:271693939); TULSA ZOO MANAGEMENT INC (US-EIN:730930870); OKLAHOMA HUMANE SOCIETY (US-EIN:208446621). Once the pool hits $10,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-OK with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: LAND LEGACY (US-EIN:300137741); OKLAHOMA ASSOCIATION OF CONSERVATION DISTRICTS INCORPORATE (US-EIN:730801393); COMPATIBLE LANDS FOUNDATION INC (US-EIN:271693939); TULSA ZOO MANAGEMENT INC (US-EIN:730930870); OKLAHOMA HUMANE SOCIETY (US-EIN:208446621).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
